input.prompt: The camera itself is completely locked off and motionless like a tripod photograph, with absolutely no zoom, no push-in, no drift, no pan and no camera movement of any kind for the entire clip. The framed beige 'NO WHISKY, NO LIFE.' pop-art poster on the wall stays perfectly rigid, flat and exactly the same size for the entire clip: its illustration, hand, rocks glass, lettering, logo, white border and proportions never warp, stretch, resize, shift position or change perspective, as if it truly is a static print and not a generated image. The only motion anywhere in this shot is the trailing green leaves of the potted plant at the right edge, which sway very gently as if touched by a soft breeze from the air conditioner; every leaf stays firmly attached. Everything else, including the wall, the warm light on the wall, the green sofa, the cushion, the scarf and especially the framed poster, is completely still and motionless. Bright, warm, cozy night in a small tidy Japanese 8-tatami one-room apartment, interior magazine photography quality. No steam, no smoke, no haze.
